items.title: China's August retail sales miss forecast while investment slump deepens, piling pressure on Beijing
items.summary: China's investment slump deepened and retail sales growth slowed further in August, while industrial output topped estimates with authorities warning of acute supply-demand imbalance at home.

items.title: Bank of America expects third-quarter investment banking fees to fall more than 10%; shares slide
items.summary: Bank of America is seeing a far more subdued few months for its Wall Street advisory and trading businesses after a blockbuster second quarter, CEO Brian Moynihan told analysts Monday.

items.title: Warsh's credibility is on the line this week as Trump policies put pressure on Fed to hike
items.summary: Before President Donald Trump reels off angry Truth Social posts if the Federal Reserve hikes rates this week, he should look in the mirror: His policies are a big reason the central bank has to consider a rate increase.

items.title: Prediction market traders think gas prices will hit new highs for the year

items.title: China says AI CEOs' call for a slowdown is 'fear mongering'
items.summary: BEIJING — China on Monday pushed back on calls by U.S. AI executives for companies to slow down the development of the cutting-edge technology.

items.title: NFL and midterm elections set up prediction markets for a critical fall season
items.summary: Prediction markets that rode politics and sports to new heights the past two years are betting on their convergence this autumn to drive even more adoption.
